input.quote: 12.1.1 Term. This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and, unless earlier terminated in accordance herewith, shall continue in force and effect until (a) the date of expiration of the last Royalty Term for the last Licensed Product, or (b) the expiration of the License Option Period and the failure of AbbVie to exercise the License Option (such period, the "Term").
input.rationale: The Agreement has no automatic-renewal mechanic. Section 12.1.1 sets a single Term running from the Effective Date until expiry of the last Royalty Term (or lapse of the License Option), and searches for "renew", "renewal term", "extension of the Term", price-uplift and CPI language return nothing in the operative terms. There is therefore no evergreen roll-over, no non-renewal notice window to compute, and no renewal price-increase right, so the conditional fallback elements (60-day non-renewal window; 5% uplift cap) and the conditional preferred elements (12-month renewal term, 30-day opt-out, 60-day reminder, CPI/3% cap) are inapplicable rather than unmet. Any extension of the Term would require a mutual written amendment: "No amendment, modification, release, or discharge with respect to this Agreement shall be binding upon the Parties unless in writing and duly executed by authorized representatives of both Parties" (Section 13.9), which satisfies the preferred position's mutual-written-agreement baseline. Section 12.1.2 further improves our position on expiry by converting the Section 5.1.3 grants to non-exclusive, fully-paid, royalty-free and irrevocable. Nothing here requires a redline; the clause sits at or above the preferred position.
